import asyncio,contextlib,importlib.util,json,time
from pathlib import Path
from pymobiledevice3.cli.cli_common import get_mobdev2_devices
from pymobiledevice3.services.notification_proxy import NotificationProxyService
ROOT=Path(r"G:\GitHub\personal-adblock-filterlist")
UDID="00008150-001A030A2E46401C"
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("replay",ROOT/"tests/ios/ios-wireless-replay.py")
replay=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(replay)
started=time.monotonic()
def report(state,**details):
    print(json.dumps(dict(state=state,elapsedSeconds=round(time.monotonic()-started,1),**details)),flush=True)
async def main():
    clients=await asyncio.wait_for(get_mobdev2_devices(udid=UDID),10)
    if not clients:
        report("NO_DEVICE")
        return 3
    ld=clients[0]
    heartbeat=None
    proxy=None
    tasks=[]
    beats=0
    notices=[]
    try:
        heartbeat=await ld.start_lockdown_service("com.apple.mobile.heartbeat")
        async def one():
            nonlocal beats
            message=await asyncio.wait_for(heartbeat.recv_plist(),25)
            if message.get("Command")!="Marco":
                raise RuntimeError(str(message))
            await heartbeat.send_plist({"Command":"Polo"})
            beats+=1
        await one()
        report("HOLD_STARTED",beats=beats,durationSeconds=420)
        async def keepalive():
            while True:
                await one()
        hbtask=asyncio.create_task(keepalive())
        tasks.append(hbtask)
        try:
            proxy=NotificationProxyService(ld)
            await asyncio.wait_for(proxy.connect(),8)
            for name in ("com.apple.springboard.lockcomplete","com.apple.springboard.lockstate","com.apple.springboard.hasBlankedScreen"):
                await proxy.notify_register_dispatch(name)
            async def observe():
                async for message in proxy.receive_notification():
                    notices.append(message)
                    report("NOTIFICATION",message=message)
            tasks.append(asyncio.create_task(observe()))
            report("NOTIFICATION_OBSERVER_STARTED")
        except Exception as error:
            report("NOTIFICATION_OBSERVER_UNAVAILABLE",error=str(error))
        for minute in range(1,8):
            await asyncio.sleep(60)
            if hbtask.done():
                await hbtask
            report("HOLD_PROGRESS",minutes=minute,beats=beats,notificationCount=len(notices))
        report("REPLAY_STARTING_WITH_KEEPER_CONNECTED",beats=beats)
        code,out,err=await asyncio.to_thread(replay.run_cmd,[__import__("sys").executable,str(ROOT/"tests/ios/ios-wireless-replay.py"),"run","--udid",UDID],timeout=120,cwd=ROOT)
        report("REPLAY_FINISHED",exitCode=code,beats=beats,stdout=out[-9000:],stderr=err[-1500:],notifications=notices)
        return code
    finally:
        for task in tasks:
            task.cancel()
            with contextlib.suppress(asyncio.CancelledError,Exception):
                await asyncio.wait_for(task,5)
        for service in (proxy,heartbeat,ld):
            if service is not None:
                await replay.close_service(service)
        report("PROBE_CLEANED_UP")
try:
    result=asyncio.run(main())
except Exception as error:
    report("PROBE_FAILED",error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")
    result=4
raise SystemExit(result)
